在 2017年8月24日星期四 UTC+8下午3:37:54，Han写道：

> Hello,
>
> I am analyzing our whole-exome sequencing data as well as our cancer-panel (including ~150 genes) data.
> When I run whole-exome sequencing using sequenza, I do not get any error, but when I use cancer-panel, I get "Something went wrong on the block counting!!".
> I updated sequenza-utils, but I still got error msg "Something went wrong on the block counting!!".
>
> Is this because of sparse data of cancer-panel sequencing?
> Does sequenza only work for whole-exome sequencing or whole-genome sequencing?
>
> Thank you,
> Han
